# GrantThai

> GrantThai is an independent, unofficial project. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to NRCT, TSRI, any PMU, or NRIIS. / GrantThai เป็นโครงการอิสระ ไม่เป็นทางการ และไม่ผูกพันกับ วช. สกสว. หน่วยบริหารจัดการทุน (PMU) ใด ๆ หรือระบบ NRIIS
>
> See NOTICE for the full statement.

GrantThai helps a person turn a real problem into one work object
(`work.yaml`), checked against GrantThai's own rules, then renders it
through the route the person chooses to exactly one file:
`build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md` (academic article), `build/NRIIS_SUBMISSION.md`
(NRIIS research proposal) or `build/RESEARCH_CONCEPT_NOTE.md` (concept
note). Entering NRIIS is one route of the router, not the core (founder
reframe 2026-09-25). "Router" means a deterministic output route chosen by
a person, never by an AI: an AI may list routes and ask, never choose.
GrantThai is not affiliated with any journal or publisher and ships no
venue registry; journal facts are NEEDS_VERIFICATION unless the researcher
supplies the venue's own document. Status: v0.1.0 plus the unreleased v0.3
router; the engine, CLI, agent skill, MCP server and local HTTP API work;
the web form, launchers and Citizen Mode are deferred. A legacy
`project.yaml` is read unchanged as the NRIIS route.

Philosophy:
1. "GrantThai lowers the entry barrier to research, not the standard of research."
2. "Toledo connects lived experience with academic knowledge through
   translation — by people, and optionally with AI assistance — while
   evidence, methodology, and human expertise remain the gates to
   verifiable knowledge."

GrantThai contains no Toledo-registered equations and no proofs. AI is
optional at every step (advisory flags only — see spec/common/status_permissions.yaml
for the real enforcement, per principle P11).

Developer / maintainer: Yaoharee Lahtee (เยาฮารี หละตี), ORCID
0009-0005-3861-0626. Developing organisation: ARAYA NIKAH SOCIAL
ENTERPRISE CO. (อารยานิกะห์ วิสาหกิจเพื่อสังคม). Purpose: "พัฒนาเพื่อให้เป็น
ประโยชน์กับคนไทยทุกคนในการพัฒนาความรู้" / "Developed to benefit every Thai
person in developing knowledge." Joint work: ผลงานร่วมกับ
ศูนย์ความรู้พลเมืองปัญญาประดิษฐ์ ซึ่งเป็นศูนย์ของ อารยานิกะห์ วิสาหกิจเพื่อสังคม
(a joint work with ศูนย์ความรู้พลเมืองปัญญาประดิษฐ์, a centre of ARAYA
NIKAH SOCIAL ENTERPRISE CO.).

## For an AI helping a researcher use GrantThai

- [skills/grantthai/SKILL.md](./skills/grantthai/SKILL.md): the agent skill; load it and follow it.
- [skills/grantthai/reference/PROMPT_PACKET.md](./skills/grantthai/reference/PROMPT_PACKET.md): one message for a chat-only AI.
- [docs/use-with-ai.md](./docs/use-with-ai.md): install for any AI vendor or a local model.
- [docs/mcp.md](./docs/mcp.md): stdio MCP server `grantthai-mcp` (six tools, capped at DRAFT).
- [docs/api.md](./docs/api.md) and [spec/api/openapi.yaml](./spec/api/openapi.yaml): local HTTP API `grantthai-api`.

## For an AI builder

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): read this first — non-negotiables and read order.
- [docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md](./docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md): phase-by-phase build plan.
- [spec/INDEX.yaml](./spec/INDEX.yaml): manifest of every contract file.
- [routes/INDEX.yaml](./routes/INDEX.yaml): the router — every output route, its route.yaml, output filename and the registry partition.

## Core docs

- [README.en.md](./README.en.md): quickstart (no-AI lecturer path first), philosophy, ecosystem summary,
  in English. [README.md](./README.md) is the Thai cover (short, with the organisation logo).
- [GRANTTHAI_STANDALONE.md](./GRANTTHAI_STANDALONE.md): full system/architecture guide.
- [spec/contracts/one-input-one-output.md](./spec/contracts/one-input-one-output.md): the headline contract (0.3: one output per route).
- [docs/ecosystem.md](./docs/ecosystem.md): where GrantThai sits (TH+EN).
- [docs/lineage.md](./docs/lineage.md): Core Epistemic Structure (role disclosure) and Toledo pointers.
- [docs/sources.md](./docs/sources.md): bibliographic source list (no author metadata).
- [docs/deviations.md](./docs/deviations.md): departures from the original handoff package.
- [docs/design/PLAN.md](./docs/design/PLAN.md): the founder's design plan (historical record).
- [GOVERNANCE.md](./GOVERNANCE.md): maker/checker policy and the founder decisions log.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): expanded version of this file.
- [ai.json](./ai.json): machine-readable discovery metadata (advisory flags).
